# Strata Procedural

> Strata Procedural is a renderer-neutral TypeScript library for deterministic procedural
> layering in 3D space: seeded noise, signed-distance composition, terrain fields,
> coherent surface layers, portable meshes, UV atlas bakes, scalar relief profiles,
> and optional Three.js/R3F adapters.

## Use the package

- Install: `pnpm add strata-procedural`.
- ESM package; supports Node.js 22 and newer.
- Import only from `strata-procedural` or its documented exports: `noise`, `sdf`,
  `terrain`, `materials`, `mesh`, `shaders`, `surface-fields`, `three`, and `r3f`.
- The root through `surface-fields` are renderer-neutral. `three` and `r3f` require
  their optional peer dependencies.
- Built-in random generators derive from an explicit string or finite numeric seed.
- `createHeightfield` reuses exact height coordinates only within one call: at most
  65,536 live samples across three actual Z-coordinate rows, with `-0` distinct from
  `0`; it falls back to direct sampling when full and does not change output buffers.
- `fractalNoise` is deterministic only when its caller-supplied sampler is deterministic
  and independent of call order. Do not
  introduce `Math.random` or rely on random-draw order without treating it as a
  compatibility change.
- Surface composition uses linear-sRGB source-over and shared scalar alpha weights.
- Wear is palette-free; UV reskinning receives portable indexed arrays.
- Sheets sample each height once and preserve valid smooth normals; conflicting
  incident corners are duplicated with outward face normals. Returned vertex count
  and index width may increase within the one-million-vertex bound.
- Optional sheet `includeCell(column, row)` selects cells once in row-major order
  before height sampling. Omitted cells retain sampled vertices/UVs; all-false
  returns empty indices supported by the generic Three mesh adapter.
- Mesh generators produce typed arrays; Three textures expose explicit disposal.
- `three.snapshotThreeStaticMeshes` copies caller-prepared static Object3D triangles
  into neutral buffers in root-relative or world coordinates without scene mutation.
  It applies inverse-transpose normals and reflected winding; missing normals are
  area-weighted. Aggregate limits: 100,000 nodes, 1,000,000 vertices, 6,000,000 indices.
  Skins, instances, batches, morphs, material groups/arrays, and partial draw ranges are rejected.
- Heightfields preserve their grid vertex/index layout. Only shared normals pointing
  behind an incident stored face fall back to `[0, 1, 0]`; valid normal bytes remain
  unchanged. This is an upward fallback, not face-normal averaging.
- Three scalar textures use linear grayscale RGBA, including bump, for WebGL1
  compatibility at the r152 peer floor; expansion uses four bytes per texel.
- `three.createThreeTriplanarMaterial` borrows bounded prepared RGBA8 maps, copies
  an affine geometry-local field transform, and creates a disposable standard PBR
  material with alpha-weighted projections and native bump perturbation. It requires
  WebGLRenderer; WebGL1 sRGB requires EXT_sRGB. No animated rest binding is supplied.
- Swept radius cusps may add coincident rings with separate shading normals;
  vertex indices are not stable across profile changes.
- Positive biome blends use overflow-safe relative weights; coordinate precision
  still bounds distinguishable distances.
- Default nearest-biome ranking also handles overflow/underflow; ordinary output
  and first-entry ties remain stable, previously incorrect extreme results change.
- The interactive source-checkout gallery runs with `pnpm build` then `pnpm demo`.

## Read next

- [Visual acceptance](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/docs/VISUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md):
  injected defects, restoration, geometry/UV diagnostics and rendered-proof limits.

- [Performance](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md):
  validated work limits, representative CPU fixtures and truthful metric definitions.

- [Compatibility](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md):
  saved seeds and normalized plans, callback limits, buffer encoding and upgrade checks.

- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/README.md): installation and
  runnable terrain, surface-bake, and scalar-relief examples.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/docs/API.md): public
  imports, exported symbols, output layouts, input rules, and adapter contracts.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  module boundaries, determinism contract, data ownership, and intentional limits.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local
  setup and verification.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-procedural/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository
  invariants for automated contributors.
